newsitem.title: UK: Wassall firm, SpecTran in tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Wassall firm, SpecTran in tie-up.

text.p: Wassall Plc said on Monday that its wholly-owned subsidiary General Cable Corporation has formed a joint venture with SpecTran Corporation of the U.S. to market fibre optic cable.
The new company will be called General Photonics, Wassall said in a statement.

General Cable and SpecTran would each hold 50 percent in the new firm. General Cable's investment would be about $6.3 million, payable in cash. "...General Photonics will be well placed to serve the fibre optic datacom market win the USA and NAFTA region," the statement said.
Wassll's chief executive Christopher Miller said General Photonics would be serving a market that exceeded 250 million stg and was growing at around 25 percent per annum.
